output_type.description: Destination for output: stdout, stderr, file, syslog, or terminal.

format_type.description: Output format: text, json, xml, or crumb.

separator.description: Delimiter string for text format output.

crumb_separator.description: Delimiter string for crumb format output.

indent.description: Number of indent characters to use.

indent_char.description: Character to use for indenting (e.g., space or tab).

output_file.description: Path to file for output when --output=file. Empty string disables file output.

file_append.description: If true, append to output file rather than overwriting.

sections.description: List of detail sections to display. Each item corresponds to a specific procenv flag (e.g., 'meta' enables -a). If empty, all are displayed by default in logic, but this template explicitly lists them if provided.

command_to_exec.description: Command to execute after running procenv when --exec is used. Empty string disables exec mode.
